647:t_006:15.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Incomprehensible... Why are there those who side with Earthlings?」

647:t_006:16.en:
$$アル$$
「You should accept the facts. With a stubborn AI like you around, I get lumped in with your kind.」

647:t_006:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't worry, Al. At least you're not as foolish as those guys.」

647:t_006:18.en:
$$アル$$
「Your choice of comparison is out of the question, Sergeant.」

647:t_006:22.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「In a sense, they too are beings whose existence was warped by the $$御使い$$s.」

647:t_006:24.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「They are the same as the $$アンチスパイラル$$. They despaired at where humanity's evolution leads, and so they reached the conclusion that humanity must be destroyed.」

647:t_006:25.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Is that how you wrecked $$ビアル星$$, home of the ancestors of $$勝平$$ and the others, and Uncle $$梅本$$'s $$ガバール星$$!?」

647:t_006:26.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「The planet where those people ended up, Earth...」

647:t_006:27.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「As expected, Earth is the root of all evil...」

647:t_006:28.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「We will erase them... all Earthlings, from every world.」

647:t_006:29.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! I've heard enough out of you guys!」

647:t_006:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「We are the ones who guard Earth...!」

647:t_006:31.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Walking the future that hope points toward, you are a guardian god who holds the radiance of the sun within! Now is the time to unleash that power!」

647:t_007:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「For your ancestors, for Uncle $$梅本$$, for everyone on Earth, we're taking down $$ガイゾック$$!」

647:t_007:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「We end $$ガイゾック$$ here! I won't let machines destroy a peaceful planet ever again!」

647:t_008:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Enemy annihilation confirmed. The remaining ships will rejoin us shortly.」

647:t_008:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Good work. Well, at least we've opened with a victory in the first battle.」

647:t_008:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Of course. We intend to keep winning, battle after battle, from here on.」

647:t_008:3.en:
$$シン$$
「The moment we lose, Earth's defeat is decided too.」

647:t_008:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「First, let's rendezvous with the other ships and head for the galactic center.」

647:t_008:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「After that, it's the fight against the $$御使い$$s...!」

647:t_008:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$... Do you know anything about the $$御使い$$s' home base?」

647:t_008:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Oh, come on... We're comrades now, so let's not keep secrets like that.」

647:t_008:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「They are certainly the greatest and strongest enemy in the True War - the so-called battle of the gods - but little is known about their true nature.」

647:t_008:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「What is certain is that they have existed far further back in the past than we, the gods of $$オリュンポス$$.」

647:t_008:12.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「No, it is longer than that.」

647:t_008:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$, who holds the memories of a $$堕天翅$$, used the words '120 million years.'」

647:t_008:14.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then those guys are also...」

647:t_008:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If the great collapse of the universe occurs on a 120-million-year cycle, then perhaps they have existed since the universe began.」

647:t_008:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Whatever they really are, we have to protect Earth from them.」

647:t_008:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we keep going like this, we'll run into those bastards again anyway. We can ask everything we want to know then.」

647:t_008:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「Let's go. Our destination is the center of the galaxy.」

647:t_008:19.en:
$$勝平$$
(I'm heading out, everyone... We took down $$ガイゾック$$, but our fight isn't over yet...)

647:t_008:20.en:
$$勝平$$
(But I'll definitely come back. Earth is our home, the place we're meant to return to.)

647:t_009:0.en:
$$勝平$$
($$ガイゾック$$...! I won't lose to you!)

647:t_009:1.en:
$$勝平$$
(I'm not the me who fought in tears after you wiped out my sleep-learning! I... I'm going to become a guardian god of Earth too!)

647:t_010:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「So $$ガイゾック$$ has really been destroyed for good...」

647:t_010:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「You can't be sure. There might still be some $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$s left somewhere.」

647:t_010:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「If they come at us, we'll deal with them.」

647:t_010:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「And it's not just us. I'm sure there are people on every planet who refuse to give in to what those guys have decided about them, and keep living their hardest.」

647:t_010:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「If those people keep at it, there's no way they'll lose to creeps like that.」

647:t_010:5.en:
$$万丈$$
(That's right, $$勝平$$. And you are one of those people who live their hardest, too.)

647:t_010:6.en:
$$万丈$$
(You're no longer a boy... You're a full-fledged warrior who protects Earth and this universe.)

647:t_011:1.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I came to see Prince $$グーラ$$ in battle, but I've been found out...」

647:t_011:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's $$ロビー$$, who was with $$グーラ$$...!」

647:t_011:3.en:
$$ロビー$$
「Please keep my presence a secret. It's not meant as thanks for that, but please accept this.」

647:t_012:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you. If you'd like, why don't you come with us, too...」

647:t_012:1.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I cannot. Even though it was an infiltration for the sake of revenge, as a subordinate of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ I have destroyed countless planets.」

647:t_012:2.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I entrust my hopes for peace to Prince $$グーラ$$, and will simply take my leave.」

647:t_012:4.en:
$$ロビー$$
「With a pure-hearted friend like you, light will surely fill the path ahead of Prince $$グーラ$$ as well.」

647:t_012:5.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I will pray for your victory from the shadows.」

647:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「You may well be stronger than us...! But that's no reason to look down on us and do as you please with our lives!」

647:t_100:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「If you're going to push your way through with power, we'll answer with power! Don't complain, you evil gods of $$ミケーネ$$!!」

647:t_101:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「You are people who relied on the power of $$皇帝ズール$$ and lost sight of what really matters!」

647:t_101:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your psychic powers and mine are supposed to open up the future! If you use them for an evil god, I will never forgive you!」

647:t_102:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is the incarnation of a black hole, then $$鉄人$$ is the messenger of the sun!」

647:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't lose, $$鉄人$$! With your power of the sun, drive away the darkness of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s minions!」

647:t_103:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Father...! If you can hear me, please listen to my words!」

647:t_103:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Earthlings have the heart that you, Father, have forgotten!」

647:t_103:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Please remember, Father! That heart is surely the power that will save the universe!」

647:t_104:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Let's do it, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$! We'll represent the $$神ファミリー$$ and take them down!」

647:t_104:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Anytime, $$勝平$$! $$ザンボット$$ will answer us, too!」

647:t_104:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「For everyone waiting on Earth, for everyone living in this universe, let's fight!」

647:t_104:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here I come, $$ガイゾック$$! No matter what you say, I'm never going to stop believing in humans!!」

647:t_105:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Revenge for the people of $$ビアル星$$, home of the ancestors of $$勝平$$ and the others! Revenge for the people of Uncle $$梅本$$'s $$ガバール星$$!」

647:t_105:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And for the enemies attacking our Earth, me, $$トライダー$$, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, and $c will be your opponents!!」

647:t_106:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ガイゾック$$, hardened into an ego you call a mission! Your existence is unforgivable!」

647:t_106:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「I believe in humans! And as a human, I will smash your ambitions!」

647:t_106:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here I come, $$ガイゾック$$! If you aren't afraid of this radiance of the sun and the gleam of the moonlight that lights the darkness, come at me!!」

647:t_107:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The battle of the gods, the battle between gods and devils - none of it matters! I too fight as a living being, for the sake of all who live!」
